```{r}
#| label: outcomessubfunc
#| cache: true
#| cache.comments: false

size_use <- 16

outcomessubfunc_inner <- function(event, time, intvar, intvarname, model) {
  levsint <- levels(escdata %>% pull(!!sym(intvar)))
  nlevsint <- length(levsint)
  modvarstmp <- setdiff(modvars, intvar)
  out <- tibble(
    pop = NA_character_,
    est = NA_real_,
    se = NA_real_,
    p = NA_real_,
    pint = NA_real_, .rows = (nlevsint + 1)
  )

  out[, 1] <- c(intvarname, paste0("  ", levsint))

  for (i in seq_along(levsint)) {
    if (model == "log") {
      modraw <- with(
        impdata,
        glm(
          formula(paste0(
            event, "~ Bili_mgdL_cat * relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
            paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
          )),
          family = binomial(link = "logit")
        )
      )
      mod <- summary(pool(modraw))

      out[i + 1, 2] <- mod[2, "estimate"]
      out[i + 1, 3] <- mod[2, "std.error"]
      out[i + 1, 4] <- mod[2, "p.value"]

      if (i == 1) {
        if (nlevsint == 2) {
          out[1, 5] <- last(mod$p.value)
        } else {
          mod_noint <- with(
            impdata,
            glm(
              formula(paste0(
                event, "~ Bili_mgdL_cat + relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
                paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
              )),
              family = binomial(link = "logit")
            )
          )

          pint <- mice::D1(modraw, mod_noint)
          out[1, 5] <- pint$result[, "P(>F)"]
        }
      }
    }

    if (model == "nb") {
      modraw <- with(impdata, glm.nb(formula(paste0(
        event, " ~ Bili_mgdL_cat * relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + offset(log(", time, ")) + ", paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
      ))))
      mod <- summary(pool(modraw))

      out[i + 1, 2] <- mod[2, "estimate"]
      out[i + 1, 3] <- mod[2, "std.error"]
      out[i + 1, 4] <- mod[2, "p.value"]

      if (i == 1) {
        if (nlevsint == 2) {
          out[1, 5] <- last(mod$p.value)
        } else {
          mod_noint <- with(impdata, glm.nb(formula(paste0(
            event, " ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + offset(log(", time, ")) + ", paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
          ))))

          pint <- mice::D1(modraw, mod_noint)
          out[1, 5] <- pint$result[, "P(>F)"]
        }
      }
    }
    if (model == "cox") {
      modraw <- with(impdata, coxph(formula(paste0(
        "Surv(", time, ",", event, ") ~ Bili_mgdL_cat * relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
        paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
      ))))

      mod <- summary(pool(modraw))

      out[i + 1, 2] <- mod[1, "estimate"]
      out[i + 1, 3] <- mod[1, "std.error"]
      out[i + 1, 4] <- mod[1, "p.value"]

      if (i == 1) {
        if (nlevsint == 2) {
          out[1, 5] <- last(mod$p.value)
        } else {
          mod_noint <- with(impdata, coxph(formula(paste0(
            "Surv(", time, ",", event, ") ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + relevel(", intvar, ", ref = '", levsint[i], "') + ",
            paste0(modvarstmp, collapse = " + ")
          ))))

          pint <- mice::D1(modraw, mod_noint)
          out[1, 5] <- pint$result[, "P(>F)"]
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(out)
}
outcomessubfunc <- function(event, time = NULL, model) {
  if (model == "log") {
    mod <- with(
      impdata,
      glm(
        formula(paste0(
          event, "~ Bili_mgdL_cat + ",
          paste0(modvars, collapse = " + ")
        )),
        family = binomial(link = "logit")
      )
    )
    rownr <- 2
  }
  if (model == "nb") {
    mod <- with(impdata, glm.nb(formula(paste0(
      event, " ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + offset(log(", time, "))  + ", paste0(modvars, collapse = " + ")
    ))))

    rownr <- 2
  }

  if (model == "cox") {
    mod <- with(impdata, coxph(formula(paste0(
      "Surv(", time, ",", event, ") ~ Bili_mgdL_cat + ", paste0(modvars, collapse = " + ")
    ))))

    rownr <- 1
  }

  # same for all models
  mod <- summary(pool(mod))
  out <- tibble(
    pop = "Overall",
    est = mod[rownr, "estimate"],
    se = mod[rownr, "std.error"],
    p = mod[rownr, "p.value"],
    pint = NA
  )

  outcomessub <- outcomessubfunc_inner(
    event = event, time = time, intvar = "ef_cat",
    intvarname = "EF (%)", model = model
  )
  outcomessub <- bind_rows(outcomessub, outcomessubfunc_inner(
    event = event, time = time, intvar = "DMSEX",
    intvarname = "Sex", model = model
  ))
  outcomessub <- bind_rows(outcomessub, outcomessubfunc_inner(
    event = event, time = time, intvar = "DMAGE_cat",
    intvarname = "Age (years)", model = model
  ))
  out <- bind_rows(out, outcomessub)

  subplot <- out %>%
    mutate(
      order = n():1,
      lci = est - global_z05 * se,
      uci = est + global_z05 * se,
      cols = factor(case_when(p >= 0.05 ~ 2, est >= 0 ~ 3, est < 0 ~ 1)),
      estci = if_else(!is.na(est), paste0(
        fn(exp(est), 2), " (",
        fn(exp(lci), 2), "-",
        fn(exp(uci), 2), ")"
      ), NA),
      pint = if_else(is.na(pint), NA, fn(pint, dig = 3, p = TRUE)),
      pop = str_replace_all(pop, "<=", "\u2264")
    )

  # plot it

  if (model == "log") {
    estname <- "Odds Ratio"
  }
  if (model == "cox") {
    estname <- "Hazard Ratio"
  }
  if (model == "nb") {
    estname <- "Rate Ratio"
  }
  xname <- paste0("Adjusted ", estname, " (95% CI)")
  xname2 <- paste0(estname, "\n(95% CI)")

  p <- ggplot(subplot, aes(x = exp(est), y = order, color = cols)) +
    # Add a reference dashed line at 1
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.6) +
    # Add dot plot and error bars
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = exp(lci), xmax = exp(uci)), width = 0.45, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 3, shape = 15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = global_cols[c(2, 3, 4)]) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = size_use, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", hjust = 0, size = size_use),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "white"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey94")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = "log", breaks = c(0.3, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4), limits = c(.3, 4)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = subplot$order, labels = subplot$pop) +
    labs(x = xname) +
    ggtitle("Bilirubin >1.0 mg/dL\nless harmfull - more harmfull")

  t <- ggplot(subplot) +
    geom_text(aes(y = order, x = 1, label = estci), size = size_use / .pt, fontface = "bold") +
    ggtitle(xname2) +
    xlab("  ") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = size_use, face = "bold"),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  pint <- ggplot(subplot) +
    geom_text(aes(y = order, x = 1, label = pint), size = size_use / .pt, fontface = "bold") +
    ggtitle("P-value\ninteraction") +
    xlab("  ") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = size_use, face = "bold"),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "white"),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(color = "white"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    )

  pall <- p + t + pint + plot_layout(ncol = 3, widths = c(3.5, 1, 0.75))

  if (output) {
    create_pptx(pall, width = 10, height = 6)
  }
  pall
}
```
